objetos.descripcion: During its activation, the unit may use this item, consuming 1 action: choose an enemy unit within 6" or less, which suffers 1D6 direct damage (no save). Explosive (1). One grenade per unit, regardless of how many miniatures it has.
During its activation, the unit may use this item, consuming 1 action, to recover 3 lost Wounds.
When the unit is declared the target of an attack (ranged or melee), before rolling any dice: ignore all damage from that attack.
During its activation, the unit may use this item, consuming 1 action: it counts as being in cover until the end of the turn.
On activation: +3" to its movement during that activation (also when Charging or Running).
When deploying, the unit may do so as if it had Vanguard, within 9" or less of an allied command post.
If it suffers damage from an attack: reduce it by 1D3.
